items.desc: Squatters in Bhaktapur refuse to leave until their housing and land ownership claims are settled, despite the administration cutting essential supplies.

items.desc: Schools have paid up to Rs500,000 for ISO certification, but education officials question the companies’ authority to assess them.

items.desc: As pet ownership rises and attitudes shift, thieves are stealing cats and dogs to supply Vietnam’s still-legal meat trade.

items.desc: In his new book, political scientist Lok Raj Baral challenges conventional ideas of geopolitical balancing and examines how Nepal can safeguard its strategic autonomy.

items.desc: Selected from 20 applicants, the three new franchises complete a 10-team lineup set to compete in a home-and-away format starting February next year.

items.desc: The 10-day tournament will be held at the Covered Hall of Dasharath Stadium from December 21 to 30, with fixtures to be announced soon.

items.title: Record-shattering swimming events wrap up with Bagmati on top
items.desc: Bagmati clinches 16 gold medals ahead of NRNA’s 12 as swimmers rewrite 15 national records over four days and 46 events in Nepalgunj.

items.title: In the age of AI, Nepali brands under pressure to reinvent themselves
items.desc: Speakers at The Himalayan Times BrandFest 2026 urge Nepali businesses to reinvent their brands in line with changing consumer expectations, embrace technology and innovation, and build on their legacy without losing the trust and human connection that distinguish them.

items.title: Chitwan’s rhinos escape poachers but face other deadly threats
items.desc: The park has recorded no poaching for more than three years, but 64 rhinos have died from other causes, including electrocution and encounters with security personnel.

items.title: Burn wards on paper, little progress on the ground
items.desc: The government's 100-point reform agenda also promises subsidised treatment, but hospitals lack the funds, equipment, and trained staff to provide specialised care.

items.desc: Without more time, projects cannot be completed by the August 2028 deadline, says an MCA-Nepal official.

items.desc: The tractor overturned at Manikanda in Jagannath Rural Municipality while travelling from Piluchaur on Friday evening.

items.desc: The digital rights group Internet Freedom Foundation has criticised the new system, saying that “censorship by automation is still censorship”.

items.desc: Amid sharp criticism over the 10th National Games, Sasmit Pokharel spells out strict reforms, regular Games and accountability for sports associations.

items.desc: Ek Narayan Aryal is being investigated over alleged fraud and organised crime linked to extra biomedical fees charged to Nepali workers seeking jobs in Malaysia.

items.title: Trump says he asked Putin to ‘pull back’ military aggression throughout Europe
items.desc: Trump did not ​elaborate on what conduct he was asking Putin to halt. Since the Russian invasion of Ukraine started in 2022, other countries have occasionally accused Russia of provocative behaviour.

items.title: Bhotekoshi flood victims may get up to Rs800,000 for new homes
items.desc: The government plans to provide one-time housing grants based on geographical regions, while families who lost their land will be included in an integrated housing programme.

items.desc: Jointly inaugurated by Prime Ministers Balendra Shah and Narendra Modi, the bridge replaces risky cable and inner-tube crossings between Nepal and India.

items.title: Displaced families protest as Bode holding centre faces eviction deadline
items.desc: Residents banged plates after receiving no food by noon, hours before the government’s 2pm deadline to vacate the centre.
